Две команды, состоящие (каждая) из 5 игроков, сражаются друг с другом, чтобы достичь и уничтожить замок («базу», «трон») противника, одновременно защищая свой для контроля пути — трёх «линий» («верхняя» — топ, «центральная» — мид и «нижняя» — бот), соединяющих замки. В игре также есть карта с изображением таймингов — «баффов» и полоской здоровья на иконке героев. Каждый игрок управляет своим персонажем («героем»). Более слабые, управляемые компьютером персонажи, называемые «миньоны», появляются на замках команд и следуют по трём линиям до замка противоположной команды, сражаясь с врагами и башнями. Также присутствует система боевых заклинаний. Главной задачей является полное уничтожение центрального замка противников.  #mobilelegends #Mlbb10th #ALLINMLBB #mlbbtiktok #mlbb

Stick with one setup and build muscle memory. ⸻ 2. Aim Accuracy (Headshots)    • Always aim at upper chest level so recoil naturally goes to the head.    • Use slight upward drag instead of pulling too hard.    • Shoot in short bursts at medium and long range.    • Practice daily in training grounds using ARs and SMGs.    • Focus on consistency, not speed. ⸻ 3. Movement & Positioning    • Never stand still during fights.    • Move left and right while shooting to make yourself harder to hit.    • Use jump and crouch during close fights to break enemy aim.    • Always fight near cover like walls, rocks, or gloo walls.    • Avoid open areas unless necessary.    • High ground gives advantage whenever possible. ⸻ 4. Na Indonésia existe uma figura do folclore que parece ter saído diretamente de um pesadelo: o Pocong. 👻🇮🇩 Segundo a lenda, o Pocong seria o espírito de uma pessoa morta que permanece preso ao próprio kafan, o tecido utilizado para envolver o corpo durante o funeral. A tradição conta que os nós do tecido deveriam ser desfeitos após o sepultamento, e quando isso não acontece, o espírito ficaria preso à mortalha. É por isso que as representações do Pocong mostram uma figura completamente coberta por um pano branco, com o corpo amarrado e se movimentando de uma maneira bastante peculiar. Em algumas histórias, ele aparece pulando ou se deslocando rigidamente durante a noite. 😨 A criatura se tornou uma das figuras mais conhecidas do terror e do folclore sobrenatural da Indonésia, aparecendo em filmes, histórias populares e relatos de supostos encontros. The Ogoh-Ogoh are giant, terrifying statues created by Balinese communities for Nyepi, the Balinese Day of Silence. 👹 Made from bamboo, paper, and other materials, these spectacular figures often represent demons and evil spirits. On the night before Nyepi, they are carried through the streets in elaborate parades, accompanied by music and traditional performances. The tradition symbolizes the purification of the island and the expulsion of negative spirits. At the end of the procession, many Ogoh-Ogoh are burned, marking the destruction of evil and the beginning of a new year in the Balinese Saka calendar. Today, creating Ogoh-Ogoh has also become a remarkable art form, with some statues reaching several meters in height and featuring incredibly detailed and frightening designs. #Bali #OgohOgoh #Nyepi #BalineseCulture #Indonesia

Kuntilanak adalah sebutan untuk hantu perempuan yang sangat populer dalam di Indonesia, khususnya di daerah Jawa dan sebagian besar daerah di Indonesia. Dalam berbagai cerita, kuntilanak digambarkan sebagai roh wanita yang meninggal saat melahirkan atau dalam kondisi hamil, dan seringkali digambarkan sebagai sosok yang pendendam dan mengganggu manusia. Kuntilanak seringkali dikaitkan dengan berbagai mitos dan cerita horor, seperti sosok yang memiliki suara tertawa melengking yang menyeramkan, atau sosok yang sering muncul di area yang sunyi dan gelap. Selain itu, dalam beberapa cerita, kuntilanak juga digambarkan sebagai sosok yang bisa menampakkan wujud fisik, seperti sosok wanita dengan pakaian putih dan rambut panjang yang berantakan. 🕯️ 10 เรื่องลึกของ “ถ้ำเสรีไทย ภูพาน” ถ้ำที่ไม่ได้ซ่อนแค่ความมืด… แต่เคยซ่อนชะตาของประเทศ ━ 1️⃣ ที่นี่ไม่ใช่ถ้ำธรรมดา ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือร่องรอยของขบวนการใต้ดินช่วงสงครามโลกครั้งที่ 2 พื้นที่ภูพานเคยถูกใช้เป็นฉากหลังของการเคลื่อนไหวลับ ที่ต้องอาศัยทั้งป่า ภูเขา และความไว้ใจของคนในพื้นที่ ━ 2️⃣ ทำไมต้องเป็น “ภูพาน” เพราะภูพานไม่ใช่แค่ภูเขา แต่เป็นแนวป่าที่ซับซ้อน มีทางเดินธรรมชาติ มีจุดหลบสายตา เหมาะกับการซ่อนคน ซ่อนของ และเคลื่อนกำลังโดยไม่ให้ถูกจับตา ━ 3️⃣ ถ้ำนี้เคยเกี่ยวกับอาวุธและเสบียง เรื่องเล่าทางประวัติศาสตร์ระบุว่า ถ้ำเสรีไทยเคยเป็นจุดสะสมอาวุธยุทธภัณฑ์และเสบียง ไม่ใช่เพื่อสร้างสงคราม แต่เพื่อเตรียมรับมือในวันที่ประเทศอาจไม่มีทางเลือก ━ 4️⃣ เส้นทางรอบถ้ำไม่ใช่ทางเดินเล่นธรรมดา เส้นทางธรรมชาติรอบถ้ำยาวประมาณ 5 กิโลเมตร ผ่านป่าเต็งรัง ป่าเบญจพรรณ จุดชมพระอาทิตย์ และทุ่งกระเจียว แต่มองอีกมุม นี่อาจเคยเป็น “เส้นเลือดลับ” ของการลำเลียงข่าวและเสบียง ━ 5️⃣ ชื่อ “ขุนพลภูพาน” ไม่ได้มาเพราะบังเอิญ เตียง ศิริขันธ์ คือหนึ่งในแกนสำคัญของเสรีไทยสายอีสาน เขาไม่ได้เป็นแค่คนในประวัติศาสตร์ แต่เป็นภาพแทนของเครือข่ายคนธรรมดาที่เลือกยืนอยู่ข้างเอกราช ━ 6️⃣ รหัสลับ “พลูโต” ในโลกของปฏิบัติการใต้ดิน ชื่อจริงอาจอันตรายเกินไป รหัสลับจึงไม่ใช่แค่ชื่อเรียก แต่มันคือเกราะป้องกันชีวิตของทั้งคนส่งข่าว คนรับข่าว และคนร่วมขบวน ━ 7️⃣ คนในพื้นที่คือกำลังสำคัญ เสรีไทยไม่ได้ขับเคลื่อนด้วยผู้นำเพียงคนเดียว แต่ต้องพึ่งชาวบ้าน ครู กำนัน ผู้ใหญ่บ้าน และคนธรรมดาที่รู้เส้นทางป่า เพราะในภูมิประเทศแบบนี้ คนรู้พื้นที่คือกุญแจของทุกภารกิจ ━ 8️⃣ ความลี้ลับของถ้ำ อาจเกิดจากความทรงจำ บางคนเล่าถึงบรรยากาศเหมือนมีคนเดิน แสงตะเกียงลึกในป่า หรือความรู้สึกเหมือนพื้นที่นี้ยังไม่เคยว่างเปล่า บางทีสิ่งที่เรากลัว… อาจไม่ใช่ผี แต่อาจเป็น “เสียงสะท้อนของประวัติศาสตร์” ━ 9️⃣ ถ้ำที่เงียบที่สุด อาจเคยดังที่สุด ในวันที่สงครามยังไม่จบ ทุกเสียงกิ่งไม้หัก ทุกแสงไฟ และทุกฝีเท้า อาจหมายถึงชีวิตของคนทั้งเครือข่าย ━ 🔟 วันนี้ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือบทเรียน มันเตือนเราว่า เอกราชไม่ได้เกิดจากคำประกาศสวยงาม แต่เกิดจากคนจำนวนมากที่ทำงานในเงามืด โดยหวังเพียงให้ประเทศยังเป็นของคนไทย ━ ทุกตำนาน… มักมีความจริงซ่อนอยู่เสมอ #โคตรลี้ลับ #บันทึกลับ #ความลึกลับ #ประวัติศาสตร์ลับ #ปริศนาโลก #ถ้ำเสรีไทย #ภูพาน #สกลนคร #เสรีไทย #ขุนพลภูพาน ⚠️ THEY SAY THE MOST TERRIFYING THING ABOUT AN ASWANG IS… DURING THE DAY, IT MAY LOOK COMPLETELY HUMAN. 🇵🇭👁️ Tonight’s nightmare is: THE ASWANG. One of the most famous supernatural beings in Filipino folklore. But first… IS THE ASWANG ACTUALLY REAL? There is no scientific evidence proving supernatural shapeshifting Aswang exist. But belief in the Aswang has been part of Philippine folklore for generations. And here’s something many people outside the Philippines don’t realize… 🌑 THE REAL FOLKLORE “Aswang” doesn’t describe just ONE monster. It can be an umbrella term for different supernatural beings depending on the region and story. Some traditions describe an Aswang as a person who appears completely normal during the day… but transforms after dark. Stories may describe Aswang that: 🐕 Transform into animals 🦇 Fly through the night 🩸 Feed on blood 👁️ Hunt people after dark 😨 Consume internal organs 🌑 Hide among ordinary communities Some legends describe creatures associated with dogs, pigs or other animals. Others resemble witches or vampires. And some stories involve beings whose bodies can separate before flying into the night. That’s what makes the Aswang so terrifying: There is no single form you can recognize. 👀 FACT THAT MAY SURPRISE YOU People sometimes confuse the Aswang with the Manananggal. But they aren’t necessarily identical. The Manananggal is usually described as a specific creature that separates its upper body from its lower body and flies using wings. “Aswang” can refer to a MUCH wider group of supernatural beings. Another famous detail? The eerie nighttime sound: “TIK-TIK… TIK-TIK…” In some folklore, hearing the sound can mean an Aswang is nearby. And the creepiest version of the warning says… if the sound becomes QUIETER… the creature may actually be getting CLOSER. 😳 🇵🇭 WHERE DO ASWANG STORIES COME FROM? Stories appear throughout different parts of the Philippines. But Panay and Capiz became especially famous for Aswang folklore. Capiz has become so strongly associated with the legend that simply mentioning the province can bring up Aswang stories for many Filipinos. But remember: These are real communities filled with ordinary people. Folklore should never be used to label or harass anyone living there. 👁️ SO WHERE CAN YOU LOCATE AN ASWANG? Scientifically? NOWHERE CONFIRMED. There is no verified Aswang habitat or supernatural creature researchers can locate. You CAN visit places connected to Filipino Aswang traditions and learn about the folklore… but you’re searching for the STORIES and cultural history. Not a scientifically documented monster. Now imagine this… 🌙 1:27 AM. You’re staying in a quiet provincial house in the Philippines. Everyone is asleep. Then you hear something outside. TIK-TIK… You ignore it. TIK-TIK… It sounds farther away. Then suddenly… nothing. Complete silence. You walk toward the window. A dog is standing beneath a tree. Completely still. You shine your flashlight at it. It slowly turns toward you. But something about its face… doesn’t look right. Then from ABOVE your roof… you hear scratching. 😳 WHAT ARE YOU DOING?! A) Locking every door immediately 🔒 B) Calling the whole family 😭 C) Recording everything 📱 D) That house belongs to the Aswang now 😂 Would you rather spend ONE NIGHT somewhere connected to Aswang folklore… OR… ONE NIGHT beside a river listening for La Llorona? 👁️ 👇 PICK ONE. Mothman? Pontianak? Krasue? Goatman? Manananggal? SAVE this before tonight. SEND it to your Filipino friend and ask: “Did your family ever warn you about the Aswang?” 😭 Because whether you believe the creature exists or not… the legend has survived through generations of Filipino storytelling. 🇵🇭👁️ #Aswang #FilipinoFolklore #HorrorTok #ScaryStories #Philippines

d: Russian artist Maria Luneva, known as Supinatra, creates surreal works using flowers, plants, insects and the human body. Instead of treating nature as decoration, she studies the shape, color and texture of each natural object and imagines what else it could become. A flower can resemble part of a face, petals can become eyelashes, and plants can transform into strange pieces of jewelry or clothing.  Her practice brings together performance, photography, sculpture and fashion, often using her own body as the surface where these transformations happen. #art #avantgarde #artist #flower #weird

'The woman with the yellow lollipop!' 😭🍭🕶️💀    If you love chaotic duos, petty friendships, and peak K-drama comedy, this iconic scene from One Dollar Lawyer (천원짜리 변호사) starring Namkoong Min and Kim Ji-eun will never fail to make you laugh!    Cornered in a bustling casino arcade by a massive squad of suited security guards, eccentric lawyer Cheon Ji-hoon (Namkoong Min) is calmly being escorted away in his sunglasses and three-piece suit. Realizing he's in serious trouble, he refuses to face the music by himself. Halting the guards, he points directly into the innocent bystander crowd: "Hang on a second. She's with us too. That woman with the lollipop... the one with the yellow lollipop!" Baek Ma-ri (Kim Ji-eun), standing quietly among onlookers mid-lick, freezes in absolute horror as the guards instantly turn around and swarm her, dragging both of them away in pure petty harmony. POV: The baby is delivered… but still inside a clear, fluid-filled bubble. 👶✨ That’s not a complication. That’s a rare and beautiful moment. This is called an en caul birth 🌊 The newborn emerges completely enclosed within the intact amniotic sac — like a tiny water balloon cradling new life. What happens next? 👇 🩺 The medical team carefully opens the membrane 💧 Amniotic fluid drains 🫁 Air reaches the lungs 👶 First breath. First cry. It looks dramatic — but it’s a natural obstetric variation. High-yield facts 📚 • Extremely rare (more common in preterm births) • Usually seen in cesarean deliveries • The sac protects the baby during birth • Requires swift but gentle membrane rupture after delivery Exam pearl 💡 En caul ≠ complication. It’s simply delivery with intact membranes. d: Bayi Reflux? 👇 Pernah menidurkan bayi setelah menyusu, lalu tiba-tiba ia menggeliat, menangis, atau terbangun karena merasa tidak nyaman? Itu bukan tanpa alasan.. dan bukan berarti bayi sedang “rewel atau cengeng.” ❌ Sering kali, penyebabnya adalah *udara yang terperangkap di dalam perut + gravitasi yang bekerja melawan mereka.* Saat menyusu (terutama bayi di bawah 4 bulan), bayi dapat menelan udara bersamaan dengan ASI atau susu. Jika udara tersebut tidak keluar, bisa menyebabkan: • perut kembung • rasa tidak nyaman • sering terbangun • gejala yang mirip reflux • tidur yang sering terputus ✨ *Apa yang benar-benar bisa membantu:* ✔️ Sendawakan bayi selama dan setelah menyusu ✔️ Gendong bayi dalam posisi tegak selama 15–30 menit setelah menyusu ✔️ Hindari langsung membaringkan bayi jika ia terlihat masih tidak nyaman ✔️ Biarkan gravitasi membantu proses pencernaan sebelum tidur Langkah kecil ini bisa memberikan perubahan besar pada kenyamanan dan kualitas tidur bayi 🌙 Ketika bayi merasa nyaman secara fisik, mereka akan lebih mudah tenang dan beristirahat dengan lebih baik 🤍 💾 SIMPAN postingan ini untuk waktu setelah menyusui ❤️ BAGIKAN kepada orang tua yang sedang menghadapi malam dengan bayi yang sering kentut, kembung, atau tidak nyaman ☎️ 0812 8832 4760 (Whatsapp) 📍Ruko Grand Galaxy RSK 2 No 7 Kota Bekasi Selatan ⏰ 10.00 - 18.00 - Buka Setiap hari #babysleepawareness #gentlesleep #newborncare #refluxsupport #babysleeptips

If you think we’re living the good life, you should know how happy and free our dog is! ❤️🐶🌴 In the Philippines, we have our own amazing dogs. They’re called Asong Pinoy (Aspin) and sometimes people refer to the more native, jungle-adapted types as Asong Gubat. They may not have fancy papers or high price tags, but they are some of the smartest, most loyal, and most resilient dogs you can have. These dogs have grown up adapting to the tropical heat, island life, and local environment for generations. That means they are naturally hardy, generally healthier, and often require less maintenance compared to many imported breeds that struggle with the climate. They’re incredibly intuitive, protective of their families, and surprisingly easy to train. Choosing to adopt an Aspin doesn’t mean there’s anything wrong with buying a purebred dog. But in a country where so many beautiful local dogs are still waiting for homes, adopting one can truly change a life.  Unfortunately, many island dogs are left abandoned and even thrown away as puppies. 💔 It’s another reality that we never see online but live with as you see them or visit the island. If you’d like to help there are a few vets and organizations doing their best to make a difference in the improvement of lives of animals here in Siargao. If you can, share your love with them!! @puppypuddlesiargao is doing amazing things by amazing women.  If you know of any other groups, please drop them in the comments!  And if you’d like to adopt dogs and puppies, there are always some As Pin (Asong Pinoy) dogs and puppies that are looking for loving and safe homes. ❤️🫶🏾🙏🏾

Video latihan tari di Sanggar Pradnya Swari, Jembrana, Bali, viral di media sosial. Anak-anak yang berlatih—baik laki-laki maupun perempuan—tampak serius menguasai nyeledet, gerak mata khas dalam tari Bali. Nyeledet bukan sekadar melirik, tetapi gerakan cepat dan tajam yang harus selaras dengan ekspresi wajah, posisi kepala, dan irama gamelan. Teknik ini dikenal sulit karena membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi serta kontrol otot mata yang kuat. Merujuk kajian seniman dan akademisi tari Bali, I Wayan Dibia, nyeledet menjadi elemen penting dalam membangun karakter tarian seperti Legong dan Kebyar, sekaligus menunjukkan kedalaman ekspresi penari. Dalam video yang beredar, anak-anak tampak berulang kali mengulang gerakan demi mencapai ketepatan. Latihan intens itu menggambarkan proses panjang di balik keindahan tari Bali yang selama ini terlihat memukau di atas panggung. #BALI #videoviral #tari

Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

Crispy garlic cheese shawarma wrap Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast and thighs mix, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste  1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 tbsp paprika powder 1 tsp sumac powder  1 tsp cumin powder  1-2 tsp red pepper flakes  2 tbsp whole milk yogurt  1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese  1 tsp parsley  Oil for cooking  For the salad: 1 red onion, thinly diced 1/2 cup tomato, diced 1 tbsp parsley, finely chopped Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1/2 tsp sumac  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil  For the creamy garlic sauce  1/2 cup mayonnaise  1/4 cup sour cream  2 cloves fresh garlic 1 tbsp lemon juice  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1/2 tsp honey 1 tbsp paprika powder  1 tsp garlic powder  To assemble: 6-7 Thin pita wrap Method: Mix chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, sumac, cumin, red pepper flakes, yogurt, olive oil and lemon juice. Coat well and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or refrigerate for a few hours. For the salad, mix onion, tomato and parsley. Season with salt, pepper and sumac, then toss with lemon juice and olive oil. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, sour cream, garlic, lemon juice, salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and honey until smooth. Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in batches without overcrowding until golden brown, crispy around the edges and cooked through. Return all the chicken to the pan, top with mozzarella and cover for 1–2 minutes until melted. Toss gently and sprinkle with parsley. Warm the pita, spread with garlic sauce, then add the cheesy chicken and salad. Fold tightly and place seam-side down in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat. Toast both sides until golden, crispy and the cheese is melty. Cut in half and serve with extra garlic sauce. #recipe #shawarma

Tried and true recipe! The perfect recipe to satisfy your takeout craving 😋 ➡️ Recipe: Beijing Beef  Serves 3-4 * 1lb skirt steak or flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain  * 1 small red bell pepper, large diced  * 1 medium onion, large diced  * 4-5 garlic cloves, finely minced  * 1 tsp grated ginger  * Frying oil  Beef marinade— * 1/2 cup cornstarch  * 2 tbsp water (add an extra 1/2tbsp if needed  * 1 tsp sesame oil  * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * 1/4 tsp baking soda  * 1/4 tsp kosher salt  * 1/8 tsp white or black pepper  Sauce— * 3 tbsp rice vinegar or 2 tbsp white vinegar  * 2 tbsp oyster sauce  * 2 tbsp ketchup  * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp sugar  * 1/2-1 tsp chili flakes (optional)  1. In a bowl, combine sesame, oil, garlic powder, baking soda, kosher salt, and white pepper with flank steak. Mix well then add cornstarch and water, mix until the meat is craggly and set aside.  2. In a small bowl, combine vinegar, oyster sauce, ketchup, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili flakes. Mix well and set aside.  3. In a large pan, heat enough oil for a shallow fry to 350°F. Carefully place marinated beef to fry and ensure each slice does not stick together for an even fry. Fry for 3-4 mins or until beef is cooked through and coated and crispy. Strain the beef and set aside. 4. In a large wok, heat 1-2 tbsp oil. Add onions and bell peppers sauté for 30 seconds or just before it turns translucent. Then add garlic and ginger and sauté for another 30 secs-1 min. 5. Make a pit in the center and pour all of the sauce. Toss with onions and bell peppers for about. Then add the fried beef. Toss until everything is combined and evenly coated with the sauce. Serve and enjoy!  #easyrecipes #chinesefood #beijingbeef #dinnerideas #takeout

d: AYAM KECAP! INDONESIAN SWEET SOY CHICKEN 🇮🇩🩷 🍗 오늘은 인도네시아 가정식 아얌 케첩(Ayam Kecap)을 만들어봤어요! 아얌 케첩은 케찹 마니스라는 인도네시아식 달콤한 간장을 베이스로 닭고기를 졸여 만드는 요리예요🤎 달콤짭짤하고 진한 소스가 부드러운 닭고기 속까지 쏙 배어 정말 맛있었어요. 향신료의 풍미와 케찹 마니스 특유의 달콤한 감칠맛이 어우러져 한국인 입맛에도 정말 잘 맞을 것 같더라고요! 특히 치즈 소스에 찍어 먹어봤는데 달콤짭짤한 아얌 케첩과 고소하고 크리미한 치즈가 생각보다 너무 잘 어울렸어요🩷 남은 닭고기와 소스에는 밥을 볶고 치즈까지 올려 마무리했는데, 개인적으로 이 조합 정말 추천합니다😊 🍗 Hari ini aku membuat Ayam Kecap, salah satu masakan rumahan Indonesia! Ayam Kecap adalah ayam yang dimasak dengan kecap manis khas Indonesia sebagai bumbu dasarnya🤎 Ayamnya empuk dan bumbunya meresap dengan rasa manis, gurih, serta aroma rempah yang kaya. Menurutku rasanya juga cocok banget dengan selera orang Korea karena perpaduan manis dan gurihnya terasa familiar! Aku juga mencoba Ayam Kecap dengan saus keju, dan ternyata kombinasi kecap manis yang gurih dengan keju yang creamy enak banget🩷 Terakhir, aku membuat nasi goreng dengan sisa ayam dan sausnya, lalu menambahkan keju. d: My In-Laws Are Coming in 15 Minutes… So I Made THIS Hashtags: #FoodTok #PastaRecipe #CookingTok #foodchallenge

My all-time favourite breakfast! 😌 Ingredients * 1 glass chickpeas (chana), soaked overnight * 2 small potatoes * 3 glasses water * 5 tbsp oil * 2 white onions * 5 dried red chilies * 1 cinnamon stick * 1 bay leaf * 2 green cardamoms * 1 star anise * 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste * 3 tbsp yogurt * 1 tbsp black pepper powder * 1 tbsp coriander powder * 1 tbsp cumin powder * 1 tbsp salt, or to taste * Green chilies, to taste * 5–6 eggs * A pinch of turmeric powder * Olive oil, for frying eggs Preparation: Method 1. Soak chana overnight, then pressure cook with potatoes and water for 15–20 minutes. 2. Sauté onions in oil until lightly golden. Add whole spices and ginger-garlic paste. 3. Blend one boiled potato, 2-3 tbs chickpeas and 3 tbs yogurt into a paste. Add to the onions and fry well. 4. Add the spices, chickpea water and salt. Bring to a boil, then add boiled chana and green chilies. Simmer briefly. 5. Lightly fry boiled eggs with olive oil and a pinch of turmeric. Add them to the chana and serve hot with paratha or naan. #fyp #viral #chickpeas #chana #egg

d: 🥔 CROQUETTES DE POMMES DE TERRE FARCIES À LA VIANDE HACHÉE 🥩 Des croquettes bien croustillantes à l’extérieur et fondantes à l’intérieur 😋✨ 🛒 Ingrédients 🥔 1 à 1,5 kg de pommes de terre 🥩 Viande hachée 🧅 1 oignon 🥚 1 à 2 œufs 🌾 Farine 🥖 Chapelure panko 🧂 Sel 🖤 Poivre 🌶️ Paprika 🌿 Origan 🍅 Concentré de tomates, facultatif 🫗 Huile de friture 🧀 Mozzarella râpé  👩‍🍳 Préparation 🥔 Faites bouillir les pommes de terre jusqu’à ce qu’elles soient bien tendres. Laissez-les ensuite refroidir complètement avant de les éplucher et de les écraser à l’aide d’un presse-purée ou d’une fourchette. 🥩 Pendant ce temps, préparez la farce. Faites revenir l’oignon émincé dans une poêle, puis ajoutez la viande hachée. 🧂 Assaisonnez avec du sel, du poivre, du paprika et de l’origan. Vous pouvez également ajouter une petite cuillère de concentré de tomates pour encore plus de goût 🍅. 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Chicken Tinola (Tinolang Manok) | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 9  Tinola a humble yet comforting chicken soup dish dates back to the pre-colonial Philippines. For my version I also used Native chicken for its added flavor along with cubes of chicken blood which is used by some households when preparing this dish INGREDIENTS: Chicken Tinola - 1 onion, sliced - 10-15 cloves of garlic, sliced - 80-100g of ginger, sliced - 1 native chicken, portioned (you can also use regular whole chicken) - 1 stalk of lemongrass - 400-500g of green papaya, cut into wedges - 6-8 pcs of green chilies - 3-5 tbsp of patis - 1-2 cups of chili leaves - 2 cups of moringa/malunggay leaves  - Chicken stock as needed - Salt and pepper to taste Chicken blood: - 1 block of chicken blood - A pinch of salt - Pepper to taste - Oil INSTRUCTIONS - Start by sauteing onions, garlic and ginger in a pot until softened. Add your sliced chicken. - Add in your lemongrass stalk, patis, and salt and pepper and cover and allow to simmer for 40mins - 1hr 30mins (depending on what chicken you use) until soft. -  add in the rest of your vegetables and simmer for 15 mins. Add in the leaves at the very last min and allow residual heat to cook them. set aside. - Add your block of chicken blood along with some salt, and boil for 10-15 minutes. Remove and slice into cubes. - Shallow fry cubes for 3-5 mins - Serve the tinola w your chicken blood and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #filipinofood #pinoyfood

Recipe below ⬇️  Bibingka (Filipino Rice Cake) Ingredients * 2 cups whole milk * 2 cups sugar * 16 oz rice flour * 1 can coconut milk (13.5–14 oz) * 4 eggs * ½ cup butter, melted * 1 tablespoon baking powder * 1 teaspoon vanilla extract Directions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Line 9x13 baking dish with parchment paper.  3. In a large bowl, whisk together the milk, coconut milk, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla. 4. Add the sugar and mix until combined. 5. Stir in the rice flour and baking powder until smooth and no lumps remain. 6. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish. 7. Bake for 1 hour, or until the center is mostly set. 8. Check for doneness:     * The edges should be lightly golden.     * The center should no longer look wet or liquid.     * A slight wobble is okay, but it should not jiggle like pudding when you gently shake the pan.     * A toothpick inserted near the center should come out mostly clean. 9. Let cool completely. The center will continue to firm up as it cools and will set even more after chilling in the refrigerator. Notes * If the center is still jiggling significantly after 1 hour, continue baking in 5–10 minute increments until it is mostly set. * Fresh from the oven, the middle may seem a little custardy. That’s normal. As it cools, it becomes chewier and more mochi-like. * For the best texture, chill for a few hours before cutting into bars.

Your kids might put you to work one day. 😂💪🏽 Marinade: • 1c cane vinegar or white • 1c soy sauce • 1 tbsp garlic powder  • 1 tbsp onion powder  • 1 tbsp coarse black pepper  Adobo: • 18-20 Boneless chicken thighs (whole Costco pack) • Dozen hard boiled eggs • 2c cane vinegar or white • 2c soy sauce  • 2c water • 1 whole white onion  • 6 russet potatoes • 10 cloves garlic  • 1 tbsp whole peppercorns • 2 tbsp white miso • 2 bay leaves Instructions: 1. Filipino Barbecue!!🇵🇭🤙🏽 | Recipe’s Jordan Should Know Ep. 12 #cooking #recipe 🇵🇭 Filipino Pork BBQ Ingredients: • 2½ lbs pork shoulder, sliced ¼-inch thick against the grain • ⅔ cup banana ketchup • 1 cup Sprite or 7Up • ½ cup soy sauce • ½ cup calamansi juice • ⅓ cup brown sugar • 8 cloves garlic, minced • ¾ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Mix the brown sugar, banana ketchup, garlic, soy sauce, calamansi juice, Sprite or 7Up, and black pepper. 2. Reserve 1 cup of the marinade for basting. 3. Add the pork and marinate for at least 4 hours, but overnight is even better. 4. Soak wooden skewers in water for about 30 minutes. 5. Fold the pork onto the skewers, keeping the pieces snug but not packed too tightly. 6. Simmer the reserved marinade for a few minutes until slightly reduced. 7. Grill over high heat, about 425–450°F. 8. Sear both sides, then turn every few minutes and brush with the reduced sauce. 9. Cook until the pork is nicely charred, sticky, and cooked through. Calamansi + Sprite or 7Up really gives Filipino BBQ that sweet, tangy flavor. 🇵🇭🔥

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

Episode 5: Homemade Garlic Longganisa 🇵🇭 (Pinoy-Style) Ingredients:  900 g ground pork 150 g pork fat (optional) 20 cloves garlic, finely minced 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp white vinegar 1 tsp paprika 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tbsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper Natural hog casing  Kitchen twine Procedure:  1. Rinse and soak the hog casing in water for 1 minute. Drain well. 2. Mix the ground pork, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, cornstarch, and cold water until sticky and well combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours 3. Stuff the mixture into the casing, being careful not to overfill. Twist and tie with kitchen twine. 4. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight to slightly dry the casing. Then freeze overnight. 4. To cook, place the longganisa in a pan with ¼ cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat until the water evaporates. Add 1–2 tbsp oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, reaching 71°C / 160°F internally. You can add any seasoning but make sure you mix it well with the meat! Pwede adobo flavor or any. Ginataang Manok  Ingredients: 4 Chicken thighs and 4-6 drumsticks Kosher salt for seasoning the chicken 1/2 onion, sliced 3 cloves garlic, minced 3/4 Cup water 2 Cans coconut milk 1 Anaheim Pepper 3 Fresno chillies (optional) use 1-2 Thai chili if you like it spicy 1 Chicken Bouillon Cube 1 Tbsp Black pepper 1 Tbsp Fish sauce 40g Ginger, cut in slices 1 Large potato 1 Large Carrot Bok Choy Instructions 1. Season the chicken generously with kosher salt. For the best flavor, refrigerate and let it season overnight. 2. Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken skin-side down until golden brown and the fat has rendered, about 5–7 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 more minute, then remove from the pot. 3. In the same pot, sauté the onions for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Pour in the water and coconut milk, then stir in the ginger, bouillon cube, fish sauce, and black pepper. Return the chicken to the pot. 5. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. 6. Add the potatoes, carrots, and Fresno chilies (if using). Continue simmering for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork-tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Taste the broth and adjust the seasoning if needed. 8. Serve hot with steamed white rice. #ginataangmanok #filipino #recipe #food #easyrecipe

Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

My wife pregnant wife was craving burgers 🍔 for dinner so I made her:  Double Gouda Burgers with Garlic Parmesan Dipping Sauce ♥️ Ingredients For the burgers: * 700 g ground beef (about 1.54 lb) * Gouda cheese, sliced * Salt and pepper * Burger buns * Lettuce * Caramelized onions For the garlic Parmesan dipping sauce: * 1 tablespoon butter * 5–6 garlic cloves, finely chopped * 200 ml heavy cream (¾ cup plus 1 tablespoon) * 100 ml milk (⅓ cup plus 1 tablespoon) * 60 g grated Parmesan (about ½–⅔ cup) * 1 tablespoon seasoning blend made with paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder * Salt and pepper, to taste * A small amount of chopped parsley For the burger sauce: * 3 tablespoons mayonnaise * 1 tablespoon mustard * Chopped pickles * Salt and pepper, to taste Instructions Step 1 – Prepare the burgers: Shape the ground beef into patties and season both sides with salt and pepper. Cook in a hot skillet until browned and cooked to your liking. Place Gouda on each patty, allow it to melt, and stack two patties together. Step 2 – Mix the burger sauce: Combine the mayonnaise, mustard, chopped pickles, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Mix until creamy, then set aside. Step 3 – Sauté the garlic: Using the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and cook for one to two minutes, just until fragrant. Keep an eye on it so the garlic doesn’t burn. Step 4 – Start the dipping sauce: Pour in the heavy cream and milk. Add the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Stir everything together and let it gently simmer until it begins to thicken. Step 5 – Finish the sauce: Add the Parmesan and stir until completely melted and smooth. Mix in the chopped parsley. The sauce should be thick and creamy but still pourable—flowing from the spoon almost like a small fountain. Step 6 – Toast the buns: Place the burger buns cut-side down in a pan and toast until golden brown and slightly crispy. Step 7 – Assemble the burgers: Spread the burger sauce on the bun, followed by the lettuce, double Gouda patties, and caramelized onions. Add the top bun, cut the burger in half, and serve with the garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping.

Cook for a minute, then pour in the heavy cream. Season with salt and pepper and let it simmer until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. The Filling Cooked chicken All of the Alfredo sauce 1½ cups mozzarella ½ cup parmesan A handful of chopped curly parsley Add everything to a bowl and mix until nice and creamy. Let the mixture cool slightly before filling your tortillas. Time to Make It Crispy Flour tortillas 2 eggs, whisked Panko Oil for frying Fill each tortilla with the chicken Alfredo mixture and roll it up like a mini burrito, making sure everything is tucked in. Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

101 Steak and Potato Variations Pt. 1: Loaded Steak and Potato Soup 🥔🥣 Comfort food season is in full swing! Gotta add this one to the menu • Ingredients: 3lbs golden potatoes, chopped 16oz steak, any cut you prefer 32 oz (4 cups) low-sodium beef stock (plus more to reach desired soup consistency) 1 medium yellow onion, diced Salt, pepper, garlic (I used Kinder's The Blend) 1lb bacon, cut into small pieces 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese, divided 4 Tbsp butter 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 12oz evaporated milk Sour cream for topping (optional) 2 Tbsp chives • Instructions -Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Drain and set aside. Reserve a little bacon for topping. -Add the potatoes, beef stock, salt, pepper, garlic to your 5.5-qt slow cooker. -Cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours, until the potatoes are very tender. -About 30 minutes before serving, puree potatoes with an immersion blender. Melt the butter in a saucepan. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1–2 minutes. -Slowly whisk in the evaporated milk until smooth and slightly thickened. -Stir the cream mixture into the slow cooker and add 3/4 of the cooked bacon, 1/2 cup of the cheddar, and the sour cream. Stir gently. -Cook another 20–30 minutes on LOW. During that time, cook the steak and cut it into small pieces. -Serve topped with the remaining cheddar, bacon, chopped steak, and chives.

Cook until fully cooked and golden. * Make the sauce: Add all the sauce ingredients to a bowl and mix well. * Make the avocado salad: Mix the chopped onion, tomato, avocado, parsley, lemon juice, and salt. * Assemble: Spread sauce over a tortilla, then add lettuce, chicken, avocado salad, and fries. Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Shrimp Stuffed Shells Ingredients 1. 20 jumbo pasta shells 2. 1 lb large shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 cloves garlic, minced 5. 1 cup ricotta cheese 6. 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 7. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 8. 1 large egg 9. 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 10. 2 tbsp cream cheese 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 16. 1 tbsp lemon juice 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Cook the jumbo pasta shells in salted boiling water until al dente. 3. Drain the shells and rinse them with cool water so they do not continue cooking. 4. Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. 5. Add the shrimp and cook for about 2 minutes per side until pink and nearly cooked through. 6. Add half of the minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. 7. Cook for another 30–60 seconds, then remove the shrimp from the heat. 8. Chop the shrimp into smaller pieces and allow it to cool slightly. 9. In a large bowl, combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, 1/2 cup mozzarella, Italian seasoning, and fresh parsley. 10. Fold the cooked shrimp into the cheese mixture until evenly distributed. 11. Melt the cream cheese into the heavy cream in a saucepan over medium-low heat. 12. Add the remaining minced garlic and stir until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 13. Stir in the lemon juice and a small pinch of salt and black pepper. 14. Spread a thin layer of the creamy garlic sauce across the bottom of a baking dish. 15. Fill each pasta shell generously with the shrimp and cheese mixture. 16. Arrange the stuffed shells in the dish and pour the remaining Alfredo sauce over and around them. 17. Sprinkle the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over the top. 18. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes. 19. Remove the foil and bake for another 8–10 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. 20. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot with extra creamy sauce spooned over the shells. Follow this account for more creamy, cheesy recipes that taste like restaurant favorites at home.

Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

Would you actually eat this street food? 😳 In this wild street food compilation, we explore some of the most unbelievable street food scenes from around the world. From massive woks full of noodles to busy street vendors cooking huge portions right in front of customers, this video shows the reality of street food markets and street food cooking that millions of people enjoy every day. Street food is famous for its bold flavors, fast cooking, and incredible variety. In many countries, street vendors prepare delicious meals in giant pans, sizzling grills, and steaming pots right on the street. But sometimes the cooking conditions can look a little questionable… which raises the big question — would you actually eat this street food? 🍜🔥 This street food video shows everything from huge noodle stir-fries and sizzling wok cooking to intense street kitchen action where vendors prepare food quickly for long lines of hungry customers. Street food markets are full of energy, heat, flames, and nonstop cooking that makes these food scenes fascinating to watch. Whether you love street food, enjoy food documentaries, or just want to see some unbelievable cooking moments, this street food compilation will definitely make you think twice.
